summary: Improve team coordination with practical diagnostics, role mapping and collaboration routines. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Team building training helps team leaders, project coordinators and supervisors diagnose coordination problems and strengthen shared work routines. Participants use GRPI and Tuckman’s stages to map friction, clarify role coverage and plan feedback or conflict responses, then create working agreements for hybrid handoffs and decision-making.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who coordinate shared work, maintain team routines or need to address role and communication gaps in a working group.
prerequisites: Basic experience working in or alongside a team is useful. No prior knowledge of team-development frameworks is required, and coding is not required.
